seoTitle: Chesterfield County Public Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates
seoDescription: Chesterfield County Public Schools (CCPS) 2027–28 calendar: Aug. 23–24 staggered start, June 2 last day, holidays, early-release dates, breaks, and calendar download.
heroSourceLine: Based on CCPS’s approved 2027–28 traditional calendar · 178 instructional days
heroSummary: Chesterfield County Public Schools uses a staggered start for 2027–28. Students in grades 1–5, 6, and 9 start Monday, August 23, while grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Tuesday, August 24. Pre-K and kindergarten students follow school-assigned staggered attendance days August 23–26, with all Pre-K and kindergarten students attending daily beginning Friday, August 27. The current live CCPS calendar lists June 2, 2028, as the last day of school.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: The first day for grades 1–5, 6, and 9 moves from August 24 to August 23. The first day for grades 7–8 and 10–12 moves from August 25 to August 24.
The current live calendar moves the scheduled last day from June 4 to June 2.
Spring Break shifts from March 29–April 2 in 2026–27 to April 3–7 in 2027–28.
Good Friday moves from the day immediately before Spring Break to April 14, one week after Spring Break ends.
October 11 is added as a student holiday.
The calendar lists nine three-hour early-release dates, compared with seven in 2026–27.
The approved calendar retains 178 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCPS start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–5, 6, and 9 start Monday, August 23, 2027. Students in grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Tuesday, August 24. Pre-K and kindergarten follow a separate staggered schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: How do CCPS's two grade-based first days work in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: CCPS uses a grade-based staggered opening. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 23; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 24. Families with children in different grade groups should plan for separate start dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When do CCPS Pre-K and kindergarten students start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Some Pre-K and kindergarten students attend on school-assigned days August 23–24, while others attend August 25–26. All Pre-K and kindergarten students attend daily beginning Friday, August 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Thanksgiving Break for CCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Wednesday, November 24, through Friday, November 26, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCPS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3, through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the three-hour early-release days for CCPS in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: CCPS lists three-hour early release on September 24, October 22, November 19, January 14, February 18, March 17, April 28, June 1, and June 2. Check your school’s bell and bus schedule for exact dismissal times.

Yes. CCPS may revise dates or schedules after weather closures or other disruptions. Use the official CCPS calendar subscription for automatic updates and check district announcements before making time-sensitive plans.
